0.1: How can we get past them? I think our best chance is to just charge on through. But to do that, we should have a shield of some sort. Do you think you can go find one? Remember, we're doing this for #p2154004#!

yes.0: Thank you so much. You're now a colleague in the alliance to rescue #p2154004#! Now go get me #b10 #t4032765#s#k! You should be able to get the #t4032765#s by hunting #r#o3150001#s#k! They don't drop very easily but be tenacious, okay?

no.0: Heh, you're a coward just like #p2152008#. I don't want to hang out with a coward, no matter how smart you are.

1.0: Wow! You really got the #t4032765#s! Thank you so much. #p2152008#, the coward, ran away but I knew you would stick with me!

yes.0: Yeah, that Black Wing gatekeeper won't know what hit him! I'll blast past him with the #t4032765#!
